name: MODE_LIST_DEFAULT_PIPE
description: Default .mode list uses '|' as separator

name: MODE_LIST_SEP_SEMICOLON
description: .mode list with .separator ';' overrides default

name: MODE_LIST_SEP_COMMA
description: .mode list with .separator ','

name: MODE_LIST_SEP_TAB
description: .mode list with .separator '\t' (tab)

name: MODE_LIST_HEADERS_ON
description: .mode list with .headers on emits column names as first row

name: MODE_LIST_NULLVALUE_NULL
description: list mode with .nullvalue NULL renders NULLs as literal NULL

name: MODE_LIST_NULLVALUE_EMPTY
description: list mode with .nullvalue "" renders NULLs as empty (default)

name: MODE_LIST_NULLVALUE_CUSTOM
description: list mode with .nullvalue '<null>' renders NULLs as the literal text

name: MODE_LIST_NULLVALUE_NA
description: list mode with .nullvalue N/A

name: MODE_LIST_HEADERS_OFF_DEFAULT_NULL
description: list mode, headers off, default null rendering (empty)

name: MODE_COLUMN_DEFAULT
description: .mode column with auto widths and headers on (sqlite3 3.45 default)

name: MODE_COLUMN_HEADERS_OFF
description: .mode column with .headers off still emits separators/widths but no header rows

name: MODE_COLUMN_WIDTH_10_8_4
description: .mode column with .width 10 8 4 forces fixed column widths

name: MODE_COLUMN_WIDTH_LARGE
description: .mode column with large widths (20 20 20) pads heavily

name: MODE_COLUMN_WIDTH_SMALL_WRAPS
description: .mode column with .width 5 5 5 wraps long values across lines
expected_stdout:
a      b      c    
-----  -----  -----
1      abc    3.14 

       longe  2.0  
       rstri       
       ng

name: MODE_CSV_BASIC
description: .mode csv basic — commas separate, embedded ' goes in unquoted-text

name: MODE_CSV_HEADERS_ON
description: .mode csv with .headers on prepends column-name row

name: MODE_CSV_HEADERS_OFF
description: .mode csv with .headers off (explicit) — no header row

name: MODE_CSV_COMMA_AND_NEWLINE
description: .mode csv quotes strings containing embedded newline / quote / separator

name: MODE_TABS_BASIC
description: .mode tabs separates with literal TAB

name: MODE_TABS_HEADERS_ON
description: .mode tabs with .headers on
expected_stdout:
a	b	c
1	abc	3.14
	a|b	2.0
42	a'b	0.5

name: MODE_LINE_BASIC
description: .mode line emits one column per line, blank line between rows
expected_stdout:
a = 1
    b = abc
    c = 3.14

    a = 
    b = a|b
    c = 2.0

    a = 42
    b = a'b
    c = 0.5

name: MODE_LINE_WITH_NEWLINE_IN_VALUE
description: .mode line preserves embedded newline inside a value verbatim
expected_stdout:
a = 1
    b = abc
    c = 3.14

    a = 
    b = a|b
    c = 2.0

    a = 42
    b = a'b
    c = 0.5

    a = 7
    b = a
b
    c =

name: MODE_HTML_BASIC
description: .mode html emits <TR><TD> rows; default headers off

name: MODE_HTML_HEADERS_ON
description: .mode html with .headers on emits <TH> header row

name: MODE_INSERT_DEFAULT
description: .mode insert without target uses "table" as the table name

name: MODE_INSERT_NAMED_TARGET
description: .mode insert t names the target table verbatim

name: MODE_INSERT_NAMED_TARGET_WITH_BLOB
description: .mode insert t including a BLOB column emits X'...' literals

name: MODE_TCL_BASIC
description: .mode tcl quotes each cell as a TCL list element

name: MODE_TCL_WITH_NEWLINE
description: .mode tcl escapes embedded newline as \n

name: MODE_TCL_WITH_BLOB
description: .mode tcl renders BLOB bytes as TCL-escaped octal sequences

name: MODE_QUOTE_BASIC
description: .mode quote emits SQL-literal-style cells; NULL stays bare NULL

name: MODE_QUOTE_WITH_BLOB
description: .mode quote renders BLOB as X'...' literal

name: MODE_ASCII_BASIC
description: .mode ascii uses 0x1F (US) field sep and 0x1E (RS) row sep

name: MODE_BOX_BASIC
description: .mode box uses Unicode box-drawing characters for a bordered table

name: MODE_BOX_HEADERS_OFF
description: .mode box always emits header row (headers off ignored for box)

name: MODE_JSON_BASIC
description: .mode json emits an array of objects; embeds doubles at full precision

name: MODE_JSON_WITH_BLOB
description: .mode json renders BLOB bytes via the 'u...' escape sequence

name: MODE_JSON_WITH_NEWLINE_AND_QUOTE
description: .mode json escapes embedded \n and \' inside string fields

name: MODE_MARKDOWN_BASIC
description: .mode markdown emits a Markdown table; always headers + separator row

name: MODE_MARKDOWN_HEADERS_OFF_IGNORED
description: .mode markdown keeps header row even with .headers off (markdown invariant)

name: MODE_TABLE_BASIC
description: .mode table emits an ASCII-art bordered table

description: sqlite3 -json sets startup mode to json before reading stdin

description: sqlite3 -html sets startup mode to html before reading stdin

description: sqlite3 -box sets startup mode to box before reading stdin
